snippet.title: Abiotic Factor - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Do you dare venture into the frigid next chapter of Abiotic Factor?

On July 22nd, 2025, Abiotic Factor is launching into 1.0 and releasing on Steam, PlayStation 5 (as part of PS+ Game Catalog) and Xbox Series X|S (as part of Game Pass). Onwards, to science!

Available now in Steam Early Access and everywhere else July 22, 2025.

Abiotic Factor is a survival crafting experience for 1-6 players set in the depths of an underground research facility. Caught between paranormal containment failure, a military crusade, and chaos from a dozen realms, the world’s greatest minds must survive against the universe’s biggest threats.
